2026Various locationsDigital tools - satellite imagery

Earth Monitoring Tools for Ecosystem Protection

This project pattern highlights digital tools that translate satellite imagery and geospatial data into practical evidence for ecosystem protection.

AdvancedEnvironment
2021ChinaPrint

Accessibility standard for textbooks

China’s GB 40070-2021 standard establishes health requirements for learning materials. This standard refers to the use of accessible font sizes and line spacing in school learning materials and classroom environments to help prevent and control myopia among children and adolescents.

EmergingSociety
2020WorldwideBillboard

Living Billboards

Living billboards, as their name suggests, seamlessly integrate live vegetation into their design, creating a captivating blend of nature and man-made structures.

EmergingEnvironment
2018United KingdomGraphic

Data visualizations - Global warming

One of the most iconic data visualizations of the last decade is the Show Your Stripes graphic, representing global warming on a planetary level, between 1850 and 2025, an increase of 1.4°.

AdvancedEnvironment
2014GlobalLanguage Digitization Initiative

Language digitalization (Translation Commons)

Translation Commons supports Indigenous and marginalized language communities by creating open tools, guidelines, and resources that help bring more languages into digital spaces.

AdvancedCulture
2012Latin AmericaPackaging

Front-of-Package Food Warning Labels

Across Latin America, food warning labels have become one of the clearest examples of communication design used as part of public health policies. In addition to the use of small nutrition tables, or technical nutrition data, these “Excess Sugar,” “Excess Sodium,” “Excess Calories,” or “Excess Saturated Fats” labels are prominently placed on the front of food and beverage packaging.
